topic: Retinal detachment: presentation and emergency management

mcqs.question: Which symptom cluster does the review give as the typical presentation of rhegmatogenous retinal detachment?

options.B: Light flashes, floaters, or a dark curtain
options.C: Gradual loss of colour vision only

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Light flashes, floaters, or a dark curtain
mcqs.explanation: The open text says the typical presentation is light flashes, floaters, or a dark curtain.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Rhegmatogenous retinal detachment typically presents with the perception of light flashes, floaters, or a “dark curtain.”

mcqs.question: Which pair does the review name as the main epidemiologic risk factors?
mcqs.explanation: The review identifies myopia and prior cataract surgery as the main risk factors.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Epidemiologic studies have identified myopia and prior cataract surgery as the main risk factors.

mcqs.question: How quickly should a patient with suspected rhegmatogenous retinal detachment be seen by an ophthalmologist?

options.B: On the same day that symptoms arise
options.C: Only if visual acuity falls below 6/60
options.D: After a routine optometry review next month
options.E: Only if the fellow eye is blind

mcqs.correctAnswerText: On the same day that symptoms arise
mcqs.explanation: The text states that all such patients should be seen by an ophthalmologist on the same day symptoms arise.

sourceRefs.excerpt: all patients should be seen by an ophthalmologist on the same day that symptoms arise

mcqs.question: Which treatment statement is in the review?

options.A: Topical antibiotics alone cure most detachments
options.B: Treatment is scleral buckle, vitrectomy, or both, with anatomical success about 85% to 90%
options.C: Laser is contraindicated in every case

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Treatment is scleral buckle, vitrectomy, or both, with anatomical success about 85% to 90%
mcqs.explanation: The review lists buckle, vitrectomy, or a combination, with anatomical success of 85% to 90%.

sourceRefs.excerpt: The treatment consists of scleral buckle, removal of the vitreous body (vitrectomy), or a combination of the two. Anatomical success rates are in the range of 85% to 90%.

mcqs.question: What does the review say follows vitrectomy in more than 70% of cases?
mcqs.explanation: The text states that vitrectomy is followed by lens opacification in more than 70% of cases.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Vitrectomy is followed by lens opacification in more than 70% of cases.
